inputs.cord: 2 to 3 mm finished breakaway necklace cord

architecture.stack: case back / battery cradle / battery / electrical insulation / PCB / component clearance / case front
architecture.battery_retention: captured removable cradle; no adhesive on pouch, leads or connector
architecture.pcb_retention: perimeter ledge plus local stops outside component courtyards
architecture.closure_for_evt: perimeter adhesive seam allowed; seam must not carry lanyard primary load
architecture.service: battery can be inserted before final EVT closure without soldering, crimping or wire modification

usb.connector_face: flush with or up to 0.3 mm behind exterior datum
usb.orientation: connector insertion axis parallel to the wearer's vertical torso axis when hanging
usb.test: charge and data with at least three ordinary USB-C overmold widths; no plug load transferred directly to PCB solder joints

microphone.location: case face directly below U8 bottom port after final PCB placement
microphone.acoustic_path: dedicated short cavity; not shared with battery or USB cavity
requirements: orientation and cavity require acoustic A/B test

lanyard.location: case edge opposite the USB connector
lanyard.hole_axis: 90 degrees from the old top-view orientation; necklace hangs with USB axis vertical
lanyard.load_path: integral with lower shell and continuous into broad back wall; not bonded-tab-only
lanyard.print_orientation: hole axis parallel to printer build Z
lanyard.qualification: 50 N three-direction proof load plus 15 N / 10000-cycle fatigue and cord-wear inspection

shape.style: pebble rounded rectangle; all exterior edges rounded

printing.supports: only where slicer/overhang review requires; none inside acoustic or USB mating surfaces after removal

release_gates: final populated-PCB STEP and battery/lead/connector envelope show no nominal interference
first print closes without forcing or compressing battery pouch
USB plug family fit and cable strain test pass
thermal charge cutoff and recovery pass in the closed case
drop test does not expose or pinch the pouch cell
